contract.form: A complete answer must give a single exact real number equal to the infimum of the set of c in [0,1] having the stated property, and justify that it is the infimum. It need not determine whether the property holds at the infimum itself.
contract.not_enough: Bounds or a range for the infimum, a numerical approximation without an exact specification, an assertion that the value is unknown or undetermined, or a value conditional on a conjecture would not settle the question. Nor would verifying or disproving the property only for selected values of c without establishing the exact infimum.
